title: Child process group cleanup
responsibility: Stops a command’s process group and follows surviving descendants that moved outside the group.

inputs.name: signalGroup.child
inputs.description: Child whose pid names the process group to signal.

inputs.name: signalGroup.signal
inputs.description: SIGTERM or SIGKILL to send to the negative child pid.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.child
inputs.description: Completed child whose process group is killed immediately.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.descendants
inputs.description: Tracker providing surviving descendant identities for follow-up cleanup.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.timing
inputs.description: Milliseconds allowed for natural settling and for graceful termination before escalation.

outputs.name: signalGroup
outputs.description: Returns nothing; attempts the group signal and ignores errors, including an already absent group.

outputs.name: groupTeardown
outputs.description: Resolves with descendants found after the settling period, after sending them SIGTERM, waiting the grace period and sending SIGKILL. Returns an empty array if none remain.
